text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Shinko Windy's lap times<n>haven't been
improving as I'd<n>hoped. I ask her if something's
changed recently.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Like, am I doing anything different?<n>Well... I've
actually been doin' a<n>whole bunch of snack pranks
lately!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm researchin' a whole<n>buncha
different snacks for my<n>pranks! You won't believe
how much<n>cake I ate today!
choice_data_list:
That's probably why your running times have
stagnated.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Graargh?! Now that ya mention it, my<n>body has
been feelin' pretty<n>sluggish!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't this bad?! I won't be able<n>to win any
races like this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I gotta get in shape! It's time for a<n>diabolical diet
double down!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But what should I do? ...Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it, Windy? Do you have<n>some
business with—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What?! Why are you running away?!<n>You haven't
done anything<n>inappropriate, have you?! Stop!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... All according to plan...With all this running, I'll be back in topform before long...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Graaagh! I hate bein' lectured! Time<n>to book it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a thrilling game of cat and<n>mouse, Shinko
Windy successfully<n>gets her body back into shape.
